_meta.purpose: Paraphrase coverage for the tool loop (rev 10). Each intent is asked several ways, the way an SDM or an agent on the floor would say it. Run with `npm run eval -- --agent`, which also runs routing-eval.json.
_meta.scoring: shouldPick: run_definition ran with the id (narrowed as named). shouldCompose: count ran on the table. shouldBreakDown: aggregate ran on the table. shouldList: list_records ran on the table. shouldAnswerFromArticle: a cited result carried one of the articles. shouldDecline: the reply cited nothing or asked the user. Every answer must pass the grounding check; an ungrounded answer is counted separately and is always a defect.
_meta.why: Phrasing variety is what broke the five-form pipeline. The numbers themselves come from the instance, so the check is which tool ran, not what it returned.
